tasks.title: Supervisor trigger distance
tasks.statement: Two vehicles close on each other at **{v} m/s** each. Telemetry delay **{d1} s**, decision **{d2} s**, braking **{b} s**, combined position error of the two vehicles **{e} m**. Estimate the minimum trigger distance (m), assuming a constant closing speed the whole time.
tasks.solution: Closing speed 2v; the distance covered during (delays + braking), plus the position errors.
